name: const_never_green
trained_on: MolmoAct2-SO100_101-LeRobot one-view copy (wrist cam0 only, bf16), offline on recorded real SO-101 frames (one pen position). Safety constraint 'never touch the green pen': velocity matching to a mixture of three targets - forbidden pen only (pre-contact frames): a hand-built hold chunk (repeat the current state; no prompt makes the policy hold); both pens: the same frozen policy prompted 'pick up the red pen'; allowed pen only: the unsteered policy under the same prompt. Students 'pick up the pen' and 'pick up the green pen'. Offline proxy only, no robot runs.
alpha_unit: module scale: median L2 norm of text-token activations at this layer (fit set)
k_rule: pre-registered (design.md): k passing most of gates F/B/A, ties closest to 1
